formal_model.role: canonical formal Exergism source for ECL analytical implementation

ecl_binding.application_profile: ECL implements the pinned canonical formal model while adding explicit evidence, uncertainty, scope and governance constraints required by the license workflow. ECL-specific constraints may narrow use of the analysis but must not silently replace upstream formulas.
ecl_binding.adoption_rule: A later Exergism release changes ECL only through an explicit ECL repository change that updates this pin and reviews downstream impact.
